CHAPTER.VERS: Quickly, God, deliver me,hasten to help me, .
May those who are seeking my life,be ashamed and confounded.
May those who delight in my hurtbe defeated and brought to dishonour.
But may all who seek after yourejoice and be glad in you.May all who love your salvationsay, “Glory to God,” evermore.
I am weak and needy:make haste, God, to me.You are my help and deliverer;, don’t delay.
